_doc: Spectrum Frontier lines. floor[f] (f = 0 Red .. 6 Violet): four intro / defeat / win lines per floor, picked by the seed; in-battle lines are 2 lines of <= 30 characters. brain: in-battle Brain lines (2 lines, <= 24 chars) and script lines (wrapped by the scripts). Rewritten 2026-10-22.

intro:
Warm-up round! Don't mind me,
I'm still out of breath.

First floor, first handshake.
Let's make it a good one.

My team's still warm from
the stairs. Ready?

Level 50, no excuses.
I like that about this place.
defeat:
Ha! Well fought!
Go on, the stairs are warm.

You warmed me up nicely.
Onward!

I'll remember that one.
Go on up.

A fair loss, and a friendly
one. Off you go.
win:
That one's on the house.
Come back with fresh legs.

Close! Breathe, regroup,
and try the stairs again.

Don't let it sting. It's
only the first floor!

Warm-ups are the hardest.
See you next climb.

intro:
Orange floor! Mind your boots,
it gets rowdy up here.

Nothing fancy here. Just
hard knocks and good cheer.

I've hauled bigger loads than
your team. Come on!

Stone and dust, friend.
Let's see what you're made of.
defeat:
Hah! That's the stuff!
Go on, I'll mop up.

You hit like a landslide.
Well done!

Fair's fair. The next floor's
all yours.

Crumbled! Good fight, friend.
Mind the rest.
win:
Dust yourself off and try
again. No shame in it.

Rough floor, rough luck.
Come back stronger.

Even rock wears down.
You'll get through.

Good scrap! The stairs
will wait for you.

intro:
Mind the rules: no wagers,
no weather, no rush.

A civilised battle, if you
please. We have an audience.

Smile. We're being watched
from behind the glass.

Rule one: look magnificent.
Rule two: win.
defeat:
Splendid! I concede with
the utmost grace.

Gracious in defeat is the
only way I know.

Bravo! The audience is
on its feet.

I protest... no. That was
clean. Go on up.
win:
A fine try. Do take a bow
on your way down.

The judges have spoken.
Better luck next time.

Not quite, darling. Practise
and return.

Applause for you both.
I merely won.

intro:
Take your time. The grove
is in no hurry.

Listen. Even the stairs
sound like leaves here.

Patience wins more fights
than power. Shall we?

I raised this team on open
roads. Show me yours.
defeat:
The wind shifted. Yours,
this time. Go on.

You grew faster than I
expected. Well done.

A good harvest. The path
is open.

Fair weather to you.
Climb safely.
win:
Grow a little more, then
come back to the grove.

Nothing is rushed here.
Try again when you're ready.

Even storms pass. Rest
and return.

Next season, then. The
stairs will keep.

intro:
Calm now. Cold, even.
Precision wins here.

The tide goes out, the tide
comes in. Let's begin.

I've timed this matchup.
Let's see if you can too.

Clear heads on this floor.
Show me yours.
defeat:
A clean read. Nicely
executed.

The tide turned. Go on
up.

I miscalculated. Rarely
happens. Well done.

Cold, correct and fair.
The stairs are yours.
win:
Not precise enough. Study
the tide and return.

Correct, but late. Try
again.

Cool your head. The next
climb will be kinder.

Exactly as calculated.
Till next time.

intro:
The tower hums an old tune.
Do you hear it?

You arrived a moment before
you knocked.

Dusk is when the quiet
things stir.

I saw you on the stairs
last week. Or next.
defeat:
The note moved.
Go on.

How odd. I remembered that
ending differently.

You're not who I expected.
Good.

Quiet again. The way is
open.
win:
I knew. I'm sorry. Come
back another evening.

The tune carries on.
So should you.

It is written. Rewrite it
next time.

Mind the shadows going
down. They follow.

intro:
Nobody here is a stranger
to the rainbow. Ready?

Seven floors, seven colours.
This last one is mine.

You made it to the top of
the round. Let's finish it.

All the colours end here.
Show me yours.
defeat:
Every colour, and you kept
your own. Splendid.

The last floor falls.
The ledger awaits.

A rainbow ends somewhere.
It ended here.

Magnificent. Go and claim
your points.
win:
So close to the top. The
ledger can wait.

The last step is the
steepest. Try again.

All seven colours, and
still one short.

The prism bends. It will
bend back.

brain._doc: In-battle Brain lines (2 lines, <= 24 chars): defeat = shown when the player wins, win = when the player loses. Script lines (intro, seal) are printed by the scripts and wrap automatically.

Lance.defeat:
A bond like that is not
taught. Well done.
Lance.win:
Not yet. A Dragon Master
is patient. Return.
Lance.intro: So you climbed all this way.{FB}I am Lance, Master of this tower. A title means little here; the stairs decide.{FB}Show me what you have built.
Lance.seal: Lance: A title could not have done that. A bond could.{FB}Take the Silver Seal. It comes with ten Battle Points, and my respect.

Anabel.defeat:
So that is how it ends.
Thank you for showing me.
Anabel.win:
I saw it. I am sorry.
Climb again.
Anabel.intro: I saw this battle before it began, and I still do not know how it ends.{FB}That has never happened to me. Please, show me.
Anabel.intro_after: The song is quiet now. I wondered whether you would come.{FB}I saw this battle before it began, and I still do not know how it ends. Shall we find out?
Anabel.seal: Anabel: The Gold Seal. I did not see that one coming.{FB}Take it, with twenty Battle Points. And thank you: it has been a long time since anything surprised me.
